# NEOM Panels — Indian Panel Manufacturing Company

> NEOM Panels is an Indian panel manufacturing company and the company behind Starwoods and NEOM Packing Plywood. Through our manufacturing foundation, focused product brands and accountable customer relationships, we help businesses choose and source panel materials with greater clarity and confidence.

## Brand Structure
- **Parent Company**: NEOM Panels (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app`) — Brand promise: *Engineered Excellence, Designed for Spaces.*
- **Active Brand 1**: Starwoods (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/starwoods`) — Plywood and engineered boards, including MDF and HDHMR where available in the current range.
- **Active Brand 2**: NEOM Packing Plywood (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/neom-packing-plywood`) — Plywood for industrial packaging requirements (packing cases, crates, dividers and protective enclosures; MR grade).
